## ⚠️ IMPORTANT

**DO NOT** open security issues publicly. Instead, please email **security@civicflow.io** with:

- Description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Potential impact
- Suggested fix (if available)

We take security very seriously and will acknowledge your report within 24 hours.

See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for more details on our responsible disclosure policy.

---

Thank you for helping keep CivicFlow secure! 🔐
